objective: Gate 5D R3 READ_ONLY: clasificar las 6 filas de Sistema_NotificacionesConfig por ColeccionOrigen y claves JSON no sensibles para reconectar config/templates/providers sin leer secretos. Auditar tambien roles/perfiles existentes aptos para permisos Communications. Sin DDL/DML. Production prohibida.

queries.name: gate5d_r3_config_collections
queries.sql: SELECT ColeccionOrigen,COUNT_BIG(*) total,SUM(CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) json_valid,SUM(CASE WHEN Activo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) active_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig GROUP BY ColeccionOrigen ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen

queries.name: gate5d_r3_config_safe_shape
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),Id) Id,MongoId,ColeccionOrigen,Activo,MigradoDesdeMongo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.canal') END canal,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modulo') END modulo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.evento') END evento,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.provider') END provider,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.modo_envio') END modo_envio,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.template_codigo') END template_codigo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.codigo') END codigo,CASE WHEN ISJSON(PayloadMongo)=1 THEN JSON_VALUE(PayloadMongo,'$.nombre') END nombre FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig ORDER BY ColeccionOrigen,MongoId

queries.name: gate5d_r3_rbac_roles
queries.sql: SELECT RolID,Codigo,Nombre,Activo FROM dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Roles ORDER BY RolID

queries.name: gate5d_r3_permission_schema
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name column_name,t.name data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_Permisos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate5d_r3_role_permission_schema
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name column_name,t.name data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos') ORDER BY c.column_id
